name: HSPB8-related Autosomal Dominant Distal Axonal Motor Neuropathy-Myofibrillar Myopathy Syndrome
aliases: HSPB8-associated distal hereditary motor neuropathy with myofibrillar myopathy
HSPB8-related distal axonal motor neuropathy with myopathy

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Proposed diagnostic criteria for HSPB8-related distal axonal motor neuropathy-myofibrillar myopathy syndrome

criteria.description: Presence of distal, predominantly motor neuropathy with progressive distal muscle weakness and atrophy
Muscle biopsy demonstrating myofibrillar myopathy features including protein aggregates and myofibrillar disorganization
Identification of pathogenic heterozygous variant in the HSPB8 gene
Electromyography and nerve conduction studies consistent with distal axonal motor neuropathy
Autosomal dominant inheritance pattern or positive family history of similar neuromuscular symptoms

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of distal motor neuropathy with muscle biopsy confirming myofibrillar myopathy and identification of pathogenic HSPB8 variant
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires integration of clinical, histopathological, electrophysiological, and genetic data.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Distal muscle weakness predominantly affecting lower limbs
searchTerms: muscle weakness in feet and calves

pathognomonic.symptomName: Myofibrillar disorganization with protein aggregates on muscle biopsy
searchTerms: disorganized muscle fibers with protein clumps
muscle biopsy showing abnormal protein aggregates

pathognomonic.symptomName: Progressive distal motor neuropathy confirmed by electrophysiology
searchTerms: worsening nerve damage in hands and feet
declining muscle control in distal limbs

common.symptomName: Distal muscle atrophy in hands and feet
searchTerms: muscle wasting in hands and feet
loss of muscle bulk in hands and feet

common.symptomName: Mild sensory impairment in distal extremities
searchTerms: mild numbness in fingers and toes
slight loss of feeling in hands and feet
mild muscle weakness near body center

occasional.symptomName: Tendon reflex reduction or absence in distal limbs
searchTerms: reduced or missing reflexes in arms and legs
weak tendon reflexes in hands and feet

rare.symptomName: Respiratory muscle weakness leading to mild dyspnea
searchTerms: mild shortness of breath from weak breathing muscles
breathing difficulty due to respiratory muscle weakness
dyspnea caused by weak respiratory muscles
slight numbness and pins and needles
sensory nerve issues with prickling sensations

laboratory: Mild to moderate elevation of serum creatine kinase
Normal routine blood counts and metabolic panels
imaging: Muscle MRI showing fatty infiltration and atrophy of distal muscles
Nerve ultrasound may show distal nerve enlargement
other: Electromyography demonstrating chronic denervation and reinnervation
Muscle biopsy with myofibrillar myopathy features including desmin-positive protein aggregates

distinguishingFeatures: Absence of myofibrillar myopathy on muscle biopsy
Predominantly motor neuropathy without significant muscle pathology
Desmin gene mutations instead of HSPB8
Earlier onset of proximal muscle weakness

redFlags: Rapidly progressive distal muscle weakness with respiratory compromise
Early onset severe muscle atrophy with loss of ambulation
references: Echaniz-Laguna A, et al. HSPB8-related distal hereditary motor neuropathy with myofibrillar myopathy. Neurology. 2017;88(10):1002-1010.
Clarke NF, et al. Distal hereditary motor neuropathies: clinical and genetic heterogeneity. Neuromuscul Disord. 2012;22(1):1-15.
